summary: HQ cursors 1: map the sheet to the existing cursor frames and slice it
author: pm
body:
Match each figure in cursors.png to the current cursor frame it replaces (frame index, size, pivot/hotspot), slice by alpha bounds, and stage the sheet plus a frame table (rects, hotspots in source pixels, scale vs. the original) under `staged/client/`.

**Done when:** every cursor frame the client draws has an HQ frame or a recorded fallback to the original.

Source: user request 2026-11-23, art working\sprite_work\cursors.png (1406x124 RGBA, measured).

**Verified, 2026-11-23:** review passed with fixes (fringe, tip) applied in the 4x re-stage; full Debug build 0 errors. In-game check is HH-0031.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: User, 2026-11-23: 'Store the cursors at whatever size you think is theoretically best for proper 4k and below scaling'. Chosen: 4x the original logical frame size. 4K's uniform UI scale is 2160/600 = 3.6 (derived), so 4x always downsamples, and its mip levels land exactly on 4x / 2x / 1x (4K, 1080p-class, 800x600). The artist sheet is about 3x (measured: hourglass 120 px for 40 logical px), so it is Real-ESRGAN upscaled 2x and Lanczos-resampled to exact 4x sizes, with edge colour bled into transparent texels against mipmap fringes.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: Review (2026-11-23): pass with fixes. Dark fringe from transparent-black texels (43% of the sheet) and the frame 0 arrow tip about 1 logical px off; both are being fixed in the 4x re-stage (edge-colour dilation, exact tip alignment). No code change needed.
